title: Multiomic Analyses Reveal Brainstem Metabolic Changes in a Mouse Model of Dravet Syndrome

evidence_spans.quote: Multiomic Analyses Reveal Brainstem Metabolic Changes
Metabolomic analyses reveal age-specific metabolic alterations

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This is a completed mouse disease-model analysis. Age-specific postnatal and older-mouse comparisons characterize Dravet syndrome pathology, without an explicit aging construct or aging-biological interpretation.

causal_design_reviewer.outcome: Brainstem metabolic, transcriptomic, and proteomic alterations
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Temporal alterations in the brain metabolome across post-natal age periods

evidence_spans.quote: We used Scn1aA1783V/WT DS mice to study temporal alterations in the brain metabolome

causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: The report describes completed multiomic analyses in a named engineered Scn1a genotype mouse model.

directional_result_reviewer.concise_rationale: The current-report results describe metabolic changes, altered genes, and reorganization of protein kinase-mediated pathways, without a matching directional X-to-Y assertion.
